name: TogglyUpdateFeatureEnv
description: Enable, disable, or configure a feature flag on a specific environment
helpMarkDown: Updates feature flag configuration for a specific environment. [Learn more](https://docs.toggly.io/integrations/azure-devops)
author: Toggly

inputs.name: teamId
inputs.label: Workspace
inputs.helpMarkDown: Select a workspace after choosing a service connection, or type the workspace ID if the list is empty.

inputs.name: applicationId
inputs.label: Application
inputs.helpMarkDown: The Toggly application. Select from the list or type the application ID.

inputs.name: environment
inputs.label: Environment
inputs.helpMarkDown: Target environment. Select from the list after choosing an application, or type the environment name.

inputs.name: featureKey
inputs.label: Feature Key
inputs.helpMarkDown: The key of the feature to configure

inputs.name: action
inputs.label: Action
inputs.helpMarkDown: Choose how to configure the feature

inputs.name: filters
inputs.label: Custom Filters (JSON)
inputs.helpMarkDown: JSON array of filter objects. Example: [{"name":"TargetingFilter","parameters":{"Audience":"beta-users"}}]
